title: RELACS: a novel in-nuclei barcoding strategy for high-throughput ChIP-seq
protocol: Grow adherent cells to reach 70-80% confluency in 10 cm cell culture plates.
Remove the medium from the cells by pouring it out.
Add 9 ml of Fixation buffer directly to the plate and incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes under gentle shaking.
Add 1 ml of 1.25 M glycine, mix thoroughly, and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Pour out the formaldehyde-glycine mixture and wash the cells twice with ice-cold PBS.
Remove the second wash of PBS and add 1 ml of ice-cold PBS supplemented with 1X protease inhibitor cocktail.
Scrape the cells off the plate using a cell lifter and collect the cell suspension into tubes of suitable volume.
If required, aliquot the suspension into several tubes before centrifuging.
Centrifuge at 300 g for 5-10 minutes at room temperature, remove supernatant, and freeze samples at -80 °C.
Transfer cells into a polypropylene 15 ml Falcon-type tube.
Centrifuge at 300 g for 5-10 minutes at room temperature.
Remove the media.
Resuspend cells in Fixation buffer at a ratio of approximately 1 ml per 1-5 million cells.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes, mixing by inverting when the cell suspension sediments.
Add 125 mM glycine final concentration directly into the fixed cell suspension using 110 μl of a 1.25 M glycine solution per ml of suspension.
Mix by inverting and centrifuge at 300 g at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant by pipetting and discard appropriately.
Resuspend cells in PBS and centrifuge at 300 g at room temperature for 5-10 minutes.
Discard the supernatant by pipetting.
Repeat the wash step using PBS supplemented with 1X protease inhibitor cocktail.
Centrifuge samples at 300 g at room temperature for 5-10 minutes.
Remove the supernatant from the samples.
Freeze the samples at -80°C.
Cut tissue into small pieces (approximately 1 cubic millimeter) in a Petri dish containing cell culture D-MEM media.
Collect the tissue using a 1 ml tip with cut tip and transfer it to a Dounce homogenizer (loose pestle, type A).
Decant and remove excess media from the tissue.
Add Fixation buffer to the tissue.
Homogenize the tissue with 2-3 strokes of the Dounce homogenizer.
Filter the preparation through a 70 µm nylon cell strainer over a Falcon tube.
Wash the strainer using Fixation buffer.
Measure the suspension volume using a graduate tip during waiting times.
Add 125 mM glycine final concentration (110 µl of a 1.25 M glycine solution per ml of suspension) when the incubation time with fixative is finished.
Mix by inverting the tubes and centrifuge at 500 g at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant from the tubes by pipetting and discard appropriately.
Resuspend cells in PBS.
Centrifuge resuspended cells at 500 g at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant by pipetting.
Avoid processing a large number of tubes simultaneously since cell pellets can easily detach.
Wash cells using PBS supplemented with 1X protease inhibitor cocktail.
Centrifuge samples \(300 g at room temperature for 5-10 minutes).
Remove supernatant and freeze samples at -80°C.
Fully resuspend formaldehyde-fixed cells with 1 ml of Lysis buffer supplemented with Protease Inhibitor Cocktail (use a pipette, do not vortex).
Check cell suspension on a phase contrast microscope using 4 μl of nuclei preparation or by DAPI staining (add directly to a microscope slide).
Transfer the cell suspension into a Covaris MilliTube containing AFA fiber.
Insert the tube into the Covaris adaptor.
Set the Covaris instrument at peak power 75 W, duty factor 2%, and 200 Cycles/burst.
Set the water bath chiller to 4 °C.
Sonicate the sample for 15-30 seconds.
Mix by inversion just before starting sonication to ensure cells are fully resuspended.
Check nuclei extraction on a phase contrast microscope using 4 µl of nuclei preparation.
Alternatively, check nuclei extraction by DAPI staining: add 4 µl of nuclei preparation plus 4 µl of DAPI working solution directly onto a microscope slide.
If the nuclei isolation is not satisfactory, prolong treatment time up to 5-8 minutes.
Proceed step by step and check the nuclei preparation under the microscope.
Transfer the nuclei preparation into a 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube.
Pellet down the nuclei (1000 g, 5 min, 4 °C).
Gently resuspend the pellet in 50 μl of 0.5% SDS and incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Add 145 μl of water to the preparation.
Add 25 μl of 10% Triton X-100 (1.1% final).
Add 25 μl of CutSmart buffer 10X (NEB).
Add 2.5 µl of 100X PIC.
Mix thoroughly to achieve a total sample volume of 250 μl.
Take 5% of the nuclei in CutSmart buffer (12.5 μl) and resuspend them in 88 μl of ChIP elution buffer.
Transfer the preparation into a Covaris MicroTube.
Sonicate for 5 minutes at Peak power: 105W, Duty factor: 2%, Cycles/burst: 200 (suggested water temperature 20 °C to prevent precipitation of SDS).
Add 2 μl of 10 mg/ml RNase A.
Add 2 μl of 20 mg/ml Proteinase K.
Add 4 μl of 5M NaCl.
Incubate for 10 min at 37 °C and at 65 °C for a minimum of 2 hours.
Purify DNA using Qiagen PCR purification kit (use MinElute column for expected cell numbers in the control sample below 50,000, otherwise use columns provided in the kit).
Elute samples in 35 μl (PCR purification kit) or 15 μl (MinElute columns).
Check DNA concentration (Qubit high sensitivity) to estimate cell number recovery (1 mouse/human diploid cells contains approximately 6.6 pg of DNA).
Use 100,000-500,000 nuclei per digestion.
Dilute samples using 1X CutSmart buffer supplemented with PIC if aliquoting is needed for cell numbers higher than 1 million.
Digest each 250 μl nuclei aliquot using 5 units of CviKI-1 per 100,000 nuclei at a concentration of 5 U/μl.
Digest overnight (approx. 16 hours) at 20 °C in an Eppendorf thermomixer set at 800 rpm.
Pellet down the nuclei at 1000 g for 5 minutes at 20 °C and remove the supernatant.
Resuspend nuclei in 200 μl of Nuclei wash solution.
Take 5% of the sample (10 μl) to check digestion efficiency.
Resuspend the 10 μl sample in 90 μl of ChIP elution buffer for a final volume of 100 μl.
Add 2 μl of 10 mg/ml RNase A, 2 μl of 20 mg/ml Proteinase K and 4 μl of 5M NaCl to the sample.
Incubate the sample at 37 °C for 10 minutes.
Incubate the sample at 65 °C for a minimum of 2 hours.
Purify DNA using Qiagen PCR purification kit (use MinElute column for expected cell numbers in the control sample below 50,000, otherwise use columns provided in the kit).
Elute samples in 35 µl using a PCR purification kit or in 15 µl using MinElute columns.
Check DNA concentration using Qubit high sensitivity to estimate cell number recovery (1 mouse/human diploid cell contains approximately 6.6 pg of DNA).
Estimate the total nuclei amount in each digested sample.
Run capillary electrophoresis to check DNA fragment size distribution.
Pellet down the nuclei at 2000 g for 5 minutes at 20 °C if samples are under-digested.
Remove supernatant and resuspend nuclei in 150 µl of Cutsmart 1X supplemented with 1X PIC.
Add appropriate amount of CviKI-1 and digest for 2-4 hours at 25-30 °C.
Pellet down the nuclei again at 2000 g for 5 minutes at 20 °C after digestion.
Remove supernatant post-digestion.
Normalize nuclei between samples by resuspending them in EB.
Resuspend nuclei into the calculated EB volume.
Dissolve nuclei clumps using NEXSON if sample contains more than 100,000 cells and nuclei are clumpy.
Transfer sonicated samples (30-130 µl volume) to Covaris microTubes.
Sonicate at NEXSON settings: peak power 75 W, duty factor 2%, and 200 Cycles/burst for 5 to 10 seconds maximum.
Prepare a master mix of End Prep Enzyme Mix and End Prep Reaction Buffer.
Aliquot 5 µl per sample containing NEBNext Ultra II End Prep Enzyme Mix (green cap, 1.5 µl) and NEBNext Ultra II End Prep Reaction Buffer (green cap, 3.5 µl).
Mix by gentle pipetting.
Spin briefly if nuclei precipitate to prevent precipitation.
Incubate in a PCR machine for 30 min at 20 °C and for 5 min at 65 °C with lid set at 75 °C.
Add 1.2 μl of barcoded adaptor to each sample.
Prepare a ligation mix including NEBNext Ultra II Ligation Master Mix and ligation enhancer as specified in the table.
Aliquot 15.5 μl of the ligation mix into each tube.
Mix by gentle pipetting.
If necessary, briefly spin samples to prevent nuclei precipitation without vortexing.
Incubate in a PCR machine at 30 °C for 15 minutes and then at 20 °C for 15 minutes (lid temperature set to 40 °C or off).
Add 300 mM NaCl final concentration to each well after ligation.
Pool all barcoded nuclei into a 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube.
Optional: Add 1X BSA final concentration if cell numbers are very low (< 100,000 total in the pool).
Pellet down the nuclei at 5000 g for 10 minutes at 20 °C.
Remove supernatant carefully to prevent pellet detachment.
Optional: Save and re-centrifuge supernatant at 11000 g for 5 minutes at 20 °C to collect any leftover pellet.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend pellets in 130 μl of ChIP shearing buffer.
Aliquot the sample into Covaris MicroTubes at 130 μl per tube.
Sonicate for 5 min at chromatin shearing settings (Peak power: 105W, Duty factor: 2%, Cycles/burst: 200).
Recover the chromatin and bring to a convenient volume using shearing buffer supplemented with PIC.
Chromatin is ready for ChIP and can be stored at 4 °C for up to one week.
Prepare separated IP-Star tube strips containing 10-30 μl of A or G-conjugated magnetic beads.
Incubate antibody for 10 hours using the pre-programmed method “ChIP_iPure_200”.
Incubate beads with antibody for 3 hours and wash beads for 5 minutes.
Elute samples from beads after washing.
Bring ChIP samples to room temperature to dissolve SDS.
Place strips on a magnet, collect supernatants, and discard the beads.
Repeat the bead removal step once more.
Prepare input samples by taking 0.1-10% of chromatin volume and bringing it to 100 μl with ChIP elution buffer.
Add Proteinase K, RNaseA, and NaCl to decrosslink ChIP and input samples.
Incubate the mixture at 37 °C for 30 min and from 4 hours to overnight at 65 °C.
Purify DNA using Qiagen MinElute columns with final elution in 21 μl EB.
Proceed with Qubit DNA HS quantification.
Freeze samples and PCR-amplify them the next day.
Mix adapter-ligated DNA fragments, USER enzyme, NEBNext Ultra II Q5 Master Mix, and Dual index primer cocktail in a PCR tube strip.
Pipette to mix components thoroughly.
Spin the PCR tube briefly.
Incubate at 37 °C for 15 minutes.
Run the PCR program with cycles starting at 98 °C for 30 seconds.
Repeat PCR cycles: 98 °C for 10 seconds followed by 65 °C for 75 seconds, according to cycle number suggestions (x10 or x12).
Perform final extension at 65 °C for 5 minutes.
Let Ampure XP beads equilibrate at room temperature for 30 minutes and vortex well before use.
Transfer each sample from tube strips to a cell culture 96-well plate.
Add 40 µl of Ampure beads (0.8X ratio) to each sample in the well plate; mix at least 10 times.
Incubate samples at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place the plate on a magnet and wait until solution becomes clear, approximately 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant, being careful not to discard the beads.
Add 200 µl of freshly prepared 80% ethanol to the plate while on the magnetic stand.
Incubate for 30 seconds and discard the supernatant.
Repeat the ethanol wash once without removing the plate from the stand.
Dry the beads at room temperature while on the magnetic stand for 5 minutes, avoiding over-drying.
Add 40 µl of EB buffer to the dried beads.
Remove from the magnetic stand and mix carefully.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Reclaim beads on a magnet and collect the samples.
Perform another Ampure cleanup with beads at a 1X ratio (40 µl) using a final elution volume of 22 µl.
Proceed with quantification of DNA concentration (Qubit DNA HS).
Control size distribution of libraries.
Final libraries can be stored at -20 °C.
Sequence the samples following Illumina guidelines (50-75 bp, paired-end, 8 bp index reads).
Include a PhiX Spike-In of 10 to 20% due to low nucleotide diversity.
Resuspend oligos in annealing buffer to a concentration of 100 µM.
Dilute oligos to 15 µM to a final volume of 100 µl in annealing buffer.
Heat diluted oligos at 95 °C for 2 min in a thermoblock.
Wait until the thermoblock cools down to room temperature.
Divide cooled oligos into suitable aliquots.
Store aliquoted oligos at -20 °C.
